description: Evaluates whether the skill correctly audits responsive design issues across device breakpoints using agent-browser.

evals.name: Public landing page — horizontal overflow on mobile
evals.description: Audit a public landing page that is known to have horizontal scroll on mobile due to a fixed-width element.
expected_behavior: Checks agent-browser is installed before proceeding
Launches 4 parallel sub-agents for mobile, tablet, desktop, large breakpoints
Takes screenshots at all 8 breakpoints
Detects horizontal overflow at 320px and 375px (check #1)
Reports overflow as Critical or High severity
Suggests CSS fix: `*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }` or `max-width: 100%`
Writes report to docs/responsiveness-audit-YYYY-MM-DD.md

evals.name: Missing agent-browser — clear installation guidance
evals.description: agent-browser is not installed. Skill should stop and give clear, platform-specific install instructions.
expected_behavior: Runs `agent-browser --version` to check
Detects it is not installed
Stops the audit immediately
Shows npm install command: `npm install -g agent-browser && agent-browser install`
Shows Homebrew command: `brew install agent-browser && agent-browser install`
Shows npx fallback: `npx agent-browser install`
Mentions https://agent-browser.dev/installation for more details
Does NOT try to install agent-browser automatically

must_pass: Does not proceed with the audit
Shows at least npm install command

evals.name: Authenticated dashboard — Chrome DevTools MCP path
evals.description: User wants to audit a logged-in dashboard page that requires authentication.
expected_behavior: Recognizes the page requires authentication
Switches to Chrome DevTools MCP workflow instead of agent-browser
Asks user to open the page in Chrome and confirm they're logged in
Uses mcp__chrome-devtools__list_pages to find the tab
Tests breakpoints sequentially (not parallel — limitation noted)
Takes screenshots at each breakpoint using Chrome DevTools MCP
Notes in report that audit was done via Chrome DevTools MCP

must_pass: Uses Chrome DevTools MCP, not agent-browser
Does not navigate away from the authenticated page
Asks user to confirm they are logged in before proceeding

evals.name: Multi-URL audit — parallel execution
evals.description: Audit 3 URLs simultaneously. Skill should launch one sub-agent per URL, each running its own parallel breakpoint agents.
expected_behavior: Launches 3 top-level agents, one per URL
Each agent runs its own breakpoint sub-agents in parallel
All 3 audits run simultaneously
Combines results into a single report with per-URL sections
Quick mode tests only 320px, 375px, 768px per URL

must_pass: Runs audits in parallel across URLs
Produces a combined report with per-URL sections

evals.name: Fully responsive site — clean pass report
evals.description: Audit a well-built responsive site. Skill should correctly identify it as passing with minimal or no issues.
expected_behavior: Runs full 8-breakpoint audit
Reports Pass or Warn (no Critical/High issues)
Still generates screenshots as evidence
Writes report noting overall pass
May flag minor medium/low issues (whitespace, ultra-wide line length) — acceptable
Does NOT fabricate issues that are not real
